content:
Developed as a practical project for my Python course, this is a powerful online homework management system designed to streamline the grading process. Built with Streamlit, it automates administrative tasks and leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) for intelligent assessment.
Key Features:
Automated Verification: Instantly compares uploaded files against a student roster to identify missing submissions. Anomaly Detection: Automatically detects duplicate files (potential plagiarism) and invalid empty files. AI-Powered Grading: Utilizes advanced Vision-Language Models (OCR) and LLMs to read PDF assignments, provide automatic scores, and generate detailed feedback. Interactive Q&A: Features a built-in AI chatbot that allows users to ask follow-up questions about the assignment or grading criteria, functioning as an intelligent teaching assistant. Get the manual by clicking here:https://pygargous.com/homework
title: Intelligent Homework Manager & AI Grader

content:
I’ve organized and documented the Blender baking workflow.
Basic Knowledge：
Z + Up Arrow: Render
G: Move/Grab (drag to move). The camera can also be moved by dragging with this.
z+上 render
g拖动 相机也可以通过这个拖动
Process：
（1）Align（对齐）
（2）choose"cycle"
（3）choose“shading”
（4）In the bottom bar, press F3 (Search), then select “Image Texture.”
(5) Create a new material: click “New.”
(6) Adjust the Bake settings as needed. Set the Bake Type to “diffuse.”
(7) Click “Output.” Select the source object to bake from, then hold Shift and select the target object to bake to.
(8) bake
title: Blender Baking Workflow Guide

content:
COLMAP Camera Visualizer Validating camera extrinsics and intrinsics from COLMAP can often be an opaque and challenging process. To address this, I developed a pipeline designed to bridge the gap between COLMAP and Blender. This tool converts COLMAP extrinsic data into standard World-to-Camera (w2c) and Camera-to-World (c2w) RT matrices, automatically generating cameras within Blender. This visualization not only makes it effortless to verify pose accuracy but also enables intuitive camera editing and inspection in a 3D space.
Click here to get the repositories（https://github.com/Henry-city/colmap-camera-visualizer）
title: Colmap-camera-visualizer

I’ve found a good open-source PDF-to-Markdown conversion model—MinerU. It has gained over 28.7k stars on GitHub and can easily convert documents, including Word, PDF, and PPT, to Markdown. It also processes LaTeX, tables, and images with high accuracy. You can deploy it on your PC via Conda, use its GUI software, or even access it through a website.
Click here to get the repositories（https://github.com/opendatalab/MinerU）
title: A good open-source PDF-to-Markdown conversion model
